author: Anonops
quote:
Finally after 13 years gta 6 is out. I have been playing gta since the first gta that came out many years ago. I have played ALL of the games up until now. 
As all the triple A titles, these corpos promise every time the reinvention of the wheel and the usual marketing speech. GTA was not different. little to no info, gameplay and that was with intention as to hype people up as much as possible. 

The game is unfinished ( mind that this game has been developed for 13 years and cost about 2 billion). bugs, glitches and a 30 fps cap in 2026 is a disaster in itself. quicktime events that are laughable, story that is as if some 16 yo teenagers sat together and thought of a really thrilling story with chores for your gf, make her happy, simp for her and so on. 
The gameplay is a distaster aswell, some parts feel like the infemous wolvorine gameplay, where you basically are invulnerable. 
GTA had always a soul, something that catched the attention and hearts of the player base. It was never about doing crime or destruction, it was about characters and stories that you as a player were curious to live as. This is what gta story was always about. These people managed to fu** up our beloved game after 13 years of evelopement and a budget similar to the GDP of a small country. 
RIP GTA
